extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF results, methods, tables, and figure captions; automated pending-review placeholders were replaced.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Melimine and Mel4 neutralize P. aeruginosa LPS activity in the LAL assay, with higher OD405 reduction for melimine than Mel4 at matched MIC multiples.
direct_assay_types: Limulus amoebocyte lysate chromogenic LPS neutralization assay
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Melimine and Mel4 against P. aeruginosa LPS
mechanism_claims.limitations: LAL neutralization supports interaction/neutralization of endotoxin activity; exact molecular binding site is discussed as likely lipid A/phosphate interaction, not directly mapped.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Both peptides rapidly depolarize the P. aeruginosa cytoplasmic membrane, measured by DiSC3-5 release, and this coincides with rapid viability loss.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Melimine and Mel4 against P. aeruginosa 6294, with source text stating similar effects across strains
mechanism_claims.limitations: Main text provides exact log-reduction summary for P. aeruginosa 6294; local supplementary landing assets did not provide additional all-strain curves.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Sytox green and Syto9/propidium iodide assays support cytoplasmic membrane permeabilization after peptide exposure, with stronger reported effect for melimine than Mel4.
direct_assay_types: flow cytometry with Syto9 and propidium iodide
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Melimine and Mel4 against P. aeruginosa 6294
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level numeric values beyond source-stated percentages/directions were not digitized; claim is limited to source-stated readout and direction.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptide exposure causes leakage of ATP and DNA/RNA from P. aeruginosa, supporting membrane-disruption-mediated loss of cellular contents.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Melimine and Mel4 against P. aeruginosa 6294
mechanism_claims.limitations: Primary source reports selected ATP percentages and time-course direction; detailed plotted curve values were not extracted from figure pixels.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Longer peptide exposure produces measurable bacteriolysis by OD620 decrease, with source-stated reductions at 2 h, 6.5 h, and 24 h.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Melimine and Mel4 against P. aeruginosa 6294 at MIC and 2x MIC
mechanism_claims.limitations: Bacteriolysis is a later event in the source timeline and should not be restated as the sole initial killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The source-supported sequence of events is LPS interaction, rapid depolarization, membrane permeabilization and ATP/DNA-RNA leakage within minutes, followed by later lysis; melimine generally produces stronger membrane-disruption readouts than Mel4.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Comparative melimine versus Mel4 mode of action
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is an adjudicated timeline summary from multiple direct assays, not a separate direct assay record.
